automationNote: GitHub Actions scheduled daily JSON validation, organizer-link checks, and dated feed backups. Link checks indicate reachability only, not event verification. Event details must be checked against the organizer's current listing.

events.title: Día de los Muertos Celebration
events.location: Museum of Contemporary Art Arlington, 3550 Wilson Blvd, Arlington, VA 22201
events.description: An evening picnic with family-friendly activities, vendors, food trucks, games, folklórico and mariachi performances, poetry, and a community ofrenda. The museum galleries stay open late.

events.title: SPARK! Not Your Usual Art Market
events.location: 2700 Art Space, 2700 S. Nelson Street, Arlington, VA 22206
events.description: An outdoor art market with local makers, food vendors, poetry, music, and hands-on art activities. November's edition includes DJ sets and free interactive art projects.

events.title: National Gallery Nights: Gratitude
events.location: National Gallery of Art, East Building, Washington, DC
events.description: An after-hours art evening with music, live performances, artmaking, and pop-up talks. The lottery opens the Monday before the event and closes Thursday at noon; limited same-day passes may be available at 5:30 PM.

events.title: DowntownDC Holiday Market
events.time: Mon–Thu 12–8 PM · Fri–Sat 11 AM–9 PM · Sun 11 AM–8 PM
events.location: F Street NW between 7th and 9th Streets NW, Washington, DC
events.description: A festive open-air market featuring 115+ local vendors, handmade gifts, art, seasonal food, and holiday finds. Closed on Thanksgiving Day.

events.title: Frosted at Franklin Park
events.location: Franklin Park, 1332 I Street NW, Washington, DC 20005
events.description: A free winter light experience with illuminated installations, a sparkling icicle walkway, oversized snowflakes, and festive photo spots. Best experienced after dark.

events.title: CityCenterDC Annual Holiday Tree Lighting
events.location: The Park at CityCenter, New York Avenue NW and 11th Street NW, Washington, DC
events.description: A downtown holiday gathering with live entertainment, family-friendly activities, holiday treats, and the lighting of CityCenterDC's 78-foot tree. Rain date: November 15.

events.title: Hirshhorn Sculpture Garden Opening Celebration
events.time: Opening day 10:00 AM–4:00 PM; weekend programs
events.location: Hirshhorn Museum and Sculpture Garden, Independence Avenue SW & 7th Street SW, Washington, DC
events.description: Celebrate the reopening of the redesigned Sculpture Garden with nearly 60 artworks, art-making activities, pop-up talks and a weekend of public programming. Check the official schedule for each day's activities.

events.title: Asia After Dark: Diwali Festival
events.location: National Museum of Asian Art, Smithsonian Institution, Washington, DC
events.description: Celebrate Diwali with food, music, dance, crafts and after-hours museum programming. Some activities have limited capacity, so review the organizer's details before going.

events.title: Pakeezah: Film Screening
events.location: National Museum of Asian Art, Washington, DC
events.description: A film program at the National Museum of Asian Art. Confirm entry requirements and any registration details on the museum's event calendar.

events.title: National Veterans Day Observance
events.location: Memorial Amphitheater, Arlington National Cemetery, Arlington, VA
events.description: A public observance honoring U.S. veterans, with a musical prelude, wreath-laying ceremony and national program. Review cemetery access and security guidance before travel.

events.title: DC Holiday Market at Dupont Circle
events.location: 1500 block of 19th Street NW, Dupont Circle, Washington, DC
events.description: A neighborhood holiday market featuring local makers, artisan goods, festive decor and seasonal treats. Check the organizer's page for vendor and schedule updates.

events.title: Handwork: Contemporary Craft at the Renwick Gallery
events.location: Renwick Gallery, 1661 Pennsylvania Avenue NW, Washington, DC
events.description: Explore contemporary craft and works from the Smithsonian American Art Museum collection in an exhibition opening at the Renwick Gallery. Confirm current hours before visiting.

events.title: ZooLights at the Smithsonian's National Zoo
events.time: Select evenings · generally 5:00–9:00 PM; Sundays until 8:00 PM
events.location: Smithsonian's National Zoo, 3001 Connecticut Avenue NW, Washington, DC
events.description: Walk illuminated paths, see animal lanterns and enjoy seasonal music during this ticketed holiday tradition. Runs on select evenings, not every night; check the official calendar for exact operating dates and ticket availability.

events.title: Adorned in Gold: Japanese Lacquer from the Jacqueline Avant Collection
events.location: National Museum of Asian Art, Washington, DC
events.description: A Smithsonian exhibition exploring Japanese maki-e lacquer, its artistry and cultural history. Check museum hours and current exhibition information before visiting.
